_meta.purpose: Legal/Ayurveda bilingual glossary for the IP-SAKTI Sahayak copilot. Legal terms retain statutory meaning; Ayurveda terms follow classical usage. Not a substitute for official Hindi statutory texts.

patent.notes: Grant under Patents Act 1970 conferring exclusive right over an invention.

trade_mark.notes: Mark capable of distinguishing goods/services (Trade Marks Act 1999).

geographical_indication.notes: Goods originating from a defined territory with qualities linked to origin (GI of Goods Act 1999).

industrial_design.notes: Novel/original configuration or ornamentation applied to an article (Designs Act 2000).

copyright.notes: Exclusive right over original literary, dramatic, musical, artistic works (Copyright Act 1957).

invention.notes: New product or process involving inventive step and industrial applicability — Patents Act s.2(1)(j).

prior_art.notes: Existing knowledge made available to the public before a filing date.

novelty.notes: Not anticipated by prior art — Patents Act s.2(1)(l), s.13.

inventive_step.notes: Non-obviousness over prior art to a person skilled in the art — Patents Act s.2(1)(ja).

industrial_applicability.notes: Capable of being made or used in an industry — Patents Act s.2(1)(ac).

exclusion.notes: Categories under s.3 that are NOT patentable inventions.

traditional_knowledge.notes: Knowledge held by Indigenous/local communities; a patent bar under s.3(p).

natural_law.en: mere discovery of a natural law / substance
natural_law.hi: प्राकृतिक नियम / प्राकृतिक वस्तु की मात्र खोज
natural_law.notes: s.3(c): mere discovery of a natural phenomenon is not an invention.

living_substance.en: merely mixing to obtain a combination
living_substance.notes: s.3(e): mere admixture resulting in aggregation of properties is excluded.

method_of_treatment.notes: s.3(i): methods of treatment of humans/animals by surgery or therapy are exclusions.

disclosure_of_origin.notes: s.10(4)(d)(ii) Biodiv requirement; GRATK/ABS dimension for biological material.

specification.notes: Full description of invention: provisional or complete — Patents Act s.10.

claims.notes: Define scope of protection — Patents Act s.10(4)(c), r.13.

filing_date.hi: दाखिल करने की तारीख / प्राथमिकता तारीख
filing_date.notes: Determines novelty comparison window and opposition windows.

examination.notes: Substantive examination under s.12-13 and First Examination Report (FER).

grant.notes: Patent sealed under s.43; term 20 years from filing — s.53.

renewal_fee.notes: Annual fee under s.53/142 to keep patent in force.

license.notes: Voluntary, compulsory (s.84), or license of right (s.86).

compulsory_license.notes: Granted under s.84 for reasonable-requirement/availability/price grounds.

anti_biopiracy.notes: Prevention of unauthorized patenting of bioresources/TK; prior-art pointers (s.3(p), BD Act).

biodiversity_act.notes: S.6 approval required for patenting an invention based on biological resources.

authority.notes: CGPDTM for patents; CDSCO for drugs; FSSAI for foods.

registration.notes: Formal record conferring rights (TM s.23, Designs s.5, Copyright s.44).

disclaimer.notes: Renunciation of protection over part of a mark or specification.

gazette.notes: Statutory publication where rules/regulations are notified.

ayurveda_formulation.notes: Processed botanical/natural formulation under Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani systems.

classical_text.notes: e.g. Charaka Samhita, Sushruta Samhita — recognized Ayurveda compendia.

patent_office.notes: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs & Trade Marks.

priority.notes: Claim to earlier filing date, typically 12 months (PCT/Paris).
